comment: Three stripes are painted, blue, amber and green, with colours set by the harness, which never reaches the recent row, so the first dump reads zero recent colours. Then the eyedropper clicks the blue, and the dump after it reads one recent colour and a 2a4d8f foreground. Then the eyedropper drags down across all three stripes and releases on the green, and the dump after it reads two recent colours, one more for the whole drag, and a 3c8c5a foreground. The shot shows the Colour Picker docker's recent row holding green then blue.
